_comment: User-edited defaults read by RiskSkill (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 7). Override per-call with explicit /risk parameters when needed. account_equity has no live source in v1 -- keep this updated by hand.

consecutive_loss_throttle.reset_condition: one subsequent WIN, or explicit logged override via /risk

_max_risk_note: max_risk_pct is THE per-trade risk ceiling for every order path, manual and automated. One authored value, one validated reader: scripts/trading_env.py MAX_RISK_PCT (via _read_max_risk_pct, which refuses rather than guessing). Its readers are strategy-runner.RISK_CEILING, scripts/trading-env.sh (PILOT_RISK_PCT clamp), scripts/session-safety-rules.sh (the SessionStart reminder) and RiskSkill/RiskAgent -- none of them may restate the number. Unified at 0.01 on 2026-09-17 by user decision: until then this file said 0.01 while trading_env.py said 0.03, so the automated pilot sized at three times what the manual /execute path enforced and the session hook announced 3%. Express it as a FRACTION (0.01 = 1%); the reader rejects anything outside (0, 1], so a `3` typed for '3%' refuses instead of risking 300% of equity.
